events.summary: 塔拉辛确认 Dominion 装置已经生效，进入密室的士兵发现附魔师全部死亡。
events.quote: His mouth snapped shut and he went pale as he realized that they were all dead.

events.summary: 塔拉辛与凯德冲出 Voidfell 密室，朝西门尖塔的接应点奔逃，士兵随后追赶。
events.quote: They bolted out of the Voidfell chamber and headed in that general direction while the soldiers gave chase.

events.summary: 塔拉辛在露天通道上抬头，看见夜帝国风暴舰 Deliverance 正悬在堡垒上空。
events.quote: Talasyn’s pace faltered as rain spattered her lashes and she looked up—looked right at the underbelly of a Night Empire stormship.

events.summary: 西门尖塔内弩箭齐射，一支铁弩箭擦过凯德头盔侧面，她受了浅伤仍继续战斗。
events.quote: Khaede was not as fortunate; one iron bolt grazed the side of her helmet with a sickening crack.

events.summary: 接应的双体船没有出现，十四名士兵封住尖塔拱门，两人被堵在塔内。
events.quote: More soldiers were swarming into the spire. Fourteen in all, barricading the archway through which Talasyn and Khaede had entered.

events.summary: 达瑞斯准将认出凯德，下令把塔拉辛与凯德铐起并压跪在地。
events.quote: Darius nodded to his men and several rushed forward to cuff Talasyn and Khaede, forcing them to their knees.

events.summary: 塔拉辛的头盔被强行摘掉，她与阿拉里克对视，看见他脸上一滴泪沿疤痕流下。
events.quote: She thought at first that it was the rain, which had tangled with the ends of Alaric’s black hair, but she soon realized that it was a lone tear

events.summary: 阿拉里克失控释放 Shadowgate，杀死达瑞斯与全部士兵、解开两人束缚，随后独自转身走进暴风雨。
events.quote: He turned around and walked away—walked back out into the raging storm—leaving the bodies of his troops scattered through the spire.

relations.relation: 夫妻（塔拉辛已嫁阿拉里克，此刻被他解救）
relations.quote: She stared at her husband as Darius and all the other Kesathese soldiers died

relations.relation: 战友／密友（一同潜入、并肩突围）
relations.quote: Talasyn screamed her friend’s name and her heart froze in its beating.

relations.relation: 前上级变 captor（曾收留提携她，如今将她上铐）
relations.quote: There was a special kind of pain in being captured by Darius, Ideth Vela’s former second-in-command who had turned traitor in the final days of the war.

relations.relation: 下属与君主（夜帝国军官向其禀报并听令）
relations.quote: “Her real name is Khaede, Your Majesty,” Darius hastily corrected.

numbers.context: 封住尖塔拱门的士兵人数
numbers.quote: More soldiers were swarming into the spire. Fourteen in all, barricading the archway through which Talasyn and Khaede had entered.

numbers.context: 按住塔拉辛的士兵人数
numbers.quote: Her hands were bound behind her back and there were three soldiers holding her down, their grips like iron.

numbers.context: 被困的两名女子（塔拉辛与凯德）
numbers.quote: Some had the two women in the sights of their crossbows; others had unsheathed their blades.

numbers.context: 阿拉里克此前失控的次数（在 Silklands）
numbers.quote: She had only seen Alaric lose control like this once before, in the Silklands
